messages:
hana.q: Heads-up: next Saturday 00:00-02:00 UTC we'll migrate CI auth from repo PATs/Okta apps to the Identity Gateway (idp-proxy). This moves machine identity to a central service and removes long-lived tokens from repos. Read: https://docs.internal/idp-proxy/ci-migration (please skim)

mira.s: Thanks. Quick ask: who should run tests and how do we validate workflows won't break?

hana.q: Dev teams: run jobs in `redwood-ci-staging` using `CI_IDP_TEST=true`. Runners owners: upgrade the runner-agent to >=0.9.2. Look for env var support and token exchange logs.

ryan.infra: Note for self-hosted: agent will fetch short-lived tokens from idp-proxy, so you should remove stored org PATs from runner machines. We'll push a configuration helper to automate cleanup.

sam.sre: Rollout plan?

hana.q: Canary rollout: ci-canary-bot will route 5% -> 25% -> 100% traffic if health checks pass. If a regression occurs we have a 30m fallback to Okta passthrough. Rollback runbook is in the doc with exact `kubectl` and ingress commands.

devex-bot: Reminder: open a migration checklist PR for your repo and tag @devex for review. Template: https://go.internal/ci-migration-template

mira.s: Any GitHub permission changes for repo admins?

hana.q: We add an org-level role "ci-runner" which service accounts will be granted. Repo admins will see invites but no automatic elevated permissions. Mapping table (repo -> service account) in the doc.

ryan.infra: Monitoring to watch: grafana panel "CI / Auth" (metrics: `ci.auth.errors`, `runners.registration.latency`, `github.actions.failure_rate`). Alerts: P1 pager, P2 slack.

ci-canary-bot: Canary sequence start: -01:00 UTC. Automated checks: workflow success rate, token exchange latency, runner registration times.

sam.sre: Security review done? Any secrets rotation required?

mira.s: Security: rotate any PATs that are still in plaintext and remove from repo secrets. We'll audit org secrets post-cutover.

hana.q: Action items recap:
- Dev teams: test by Fri EOD, file PR checklist
- Runner owners: upgrade agent to 0.9.2+
- Repo admins: expect invites and verify mappings
- Security: audit secrets and approve mappings

mira.s: I'll run a readiness sweep Friday 15:00 UTC and report status here.

hana.q: Thanks everyone. Post blockers in this thread and ping @ryan.infra or @sam.sre for emergencies. :thumbsup:\n
